decisions.reason: Magicless frames are a supported format of the stream decoder. The old target uses that decoder but never selects the format, so no fuzz input can exercise magicless decoding through this target.
decisions.finite_witness: Use a seed prefix of FUZZ_RNG_SEED_SIZE bytes followed by 20 01 09 00 00 41. The suffix encodes a magicless frame with one final raw block containing 41. With ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless selected before decoding, the format-aware header parser accepts it; the target retains ZSTD_f_zstd1.
